create.name: John Butler
create.bio:
John Butler is an English meditation teacher and author who lives in the Derbyshire Peak District, near Bakewell and a short drive from Sheffield. Born in 1937, he spent much of his working life as a farmer and in the 1970s was one of the early British organic growers, the subject of a BBC film about his small Lincolnshire holding. Alongside farming he travelled and lived for long spells in Peru, Africa, the United States and Russia, studied Slavonic languages at Nottingham, and kept up a daily practice of prayer and meditation for decades.

He came to a wide audience in his late seventies after a long filmed conversation about his life, and since then he and his collaborator Phil Shankland have built the Spiritual Unfoldment channel. His teaching belongs to no school: he speaks from his own experience within a broadly Christian mystical outlook, using plain examples from nature and farm life. His best-known advice is to feel your feet on the ground, look and listen, and let the mind settle into silence and a sense of presence. He has written ten books, from Wonders of Spiritual Unfoldment to Of Mystic Union, which he reads himself as audiobooks, and he occasionally leads small residential weekends in Yorkshire.

books.title: Wonders of Spiritual Unfoldment
books.author: John Butler
books.description: His first book, published by Shepheard-Walwyn in 2008. It tells how a restless young man went looking for love and purpose, from a South American mountainside to the farm, and how prayer and meditation slowly reshaped his life.

books.title: Mystic Approaches
books.author: John Butler
books.description: The follow-up to his first book, going back to the farming years where his mystical life took root. It looks at serving the land and the world through prayer, and at the self-willed ego as the main thing standing in the way.

courses.title: Of Mystic Union (audiobook)
courses.description: His latest book, which he has said will be his last, read in full by John himself across some thirty-four hours. It follows the old theme of two becoming one, from human love to union with God, and is delivered through the free BookFunnel app.

free_resources.title: Common Sense Guide To Meditation #1 Feet On The Ground
free_resources.description: The opening talk of his best-known series, about 24 minutes long, on settling attention in the body and the senses as the doorway to stillness. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Come To Deeper Silence
free_resources.description: A 23-minute guided sitting in which he leads the listener gently from noise and thought into quiet. Free to play on Insight Timer.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @SpiritualUnfoldment 239K subscribers (channel header, 3 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 120 followers (profile, 3 Nov 2026); Facebook and Instagram linked from his site but not opened (blocked); Spotify not counted → ~239k readable → luminary
flags: Base: his Insight Timer profile gives Bakewell DE45 (Derbyshire Peak District, about 13 miles from Sheffield centre); Wikipedia and press describe him as living in Derbyshire 'near Sheffield'; the Spiritual Unfoldment Trust's published 'Find us' address is in Sheffield city centre (S1). I used Bakewell as where he lives; a human may prefer the Trust's Sheffield address, or may judge Bakewell too far from Sheffield for this sprint.
He was born in 1937 (age 89); the channel and bookshop were active in August 2026 and a retreat ran in September 2026, so he is treated as still teaching.
The email is the Spiritual Unfoldment Trust inbox (info@), published in the footer of every page.
Only one photo used: the 'Who is Mr Nothing' still on his own site. The YouTube avatar is his face but overlaid with the channel name, so it is left out.
The YouTube channel is run with his producer Phil Shankland (InSight New Media) for the Spiritual Unfoldment Trust; it presents only John, so its subscribers are counted.

Videos are the most-viewed teaching talks among the 30 most recent uploads; his best-known older videos (the Conscious TV interview and the full Common Sense Guide to Meditation series on YouTube) could not be found without YouTube search, which is not used.

Mystic Approaches: ISBN 9780993041006 appears only as the cover-image file name on his own shop page; Open Library confirms it as Mystic Approaches by John Butler (https://openlibrary.org/books/OL42929298M), ISBN-10 converted as 0993041000.

Wonders of Spiritual Unfoldment: ISBN-13 978-0856832604 is published on his shop page; Open Library confirms it (https://openlibrary.org/books/OL25558339M, Shepheard-Walwyn 2010 record), ISBN-10 converted as 0856832604.
His teaching is explicitly Christian-mystical (the site invites 'devotion to God'); the Trust page mentions sin and its 'lawful consequence', which is religious language, not conspiracy content.

The ingest check notes Bakewell is not in the places table (under 5,000 people): it needs a place alias (e.g. Bakewell → Derbyshire Dales / near Sheffield) for Near You, or the city can be switched to Sheffield (the Trust's published address).
left_out: Books Mystic Beginnings, Mystic Burning, Mystic Yearning, Of Mystic Union (paperback), Mystic Forbearance in Russia, Mystic Naturally, Mystic Verses and Mystic Apprentice: ISBNs not confirmed on Open Library (404) or not published.
Mystic Love and its audiobook: the blurb names depression.
Retreats 'Abiding in Truth' (Ilkley, 25 to 27 Sep 2026): past; no future retreat announced.
YouTube channel membership 'Feet on the Ground': price only visible when logged in.
Free 86-page PDF 'Introducing Spiritual Unfoldment': only by joining the email list.
Short notices and appeals on the channel (bookshop news, 'Supporting the Work', retreat invitations, kirtan clip).
Video 'Towards Simplicity #3 - Death - The greatest blessing?' (fine in itself, but left out to keep the list to ten).
